skill_card.name: Change Impact Analysis Skill
skill_card.description: A polyglot, deterministic deployment-phase skill that analyzes changed files or git diffs to build a dependency graph, determine the blast radius, validate API contract compatibility, map ownership, and compute a 0–100 release risk score with an actionable deployment checklist.

tasks.name: Detect changed files
tasks.description: Uses git diff or a filesystem fallback to identify the repository changes to analyze and determine the input set for downstream impact assessment.
tasks.input_schema: Repository path, base branch, changed file list or git diff trigger.
tasks.output_schema: Normalized changed file set and change detection method.

tasks.name: Build dependency graph and blast radius
tasks.description: Parses source code across multi-language repositories, constructs a directed dependency graph, and reverse-traverses it to find directly and transitively affected modules.
tasks.input_schema: Repository path and changed file set.
tasks.output_schema: Impacted modules, affected APIs, regression areas, consumer applications, and direct/transitive impact counts.

tasks.name: Generate deployment artifacts
tasks.description: Validates API contract compatibility, computes a deterministic 0–100 deployment risk score, and emits an impact report plus a deployment checklist for release decision support.
tasks.input_schema: Impact analysis results, contract validation findings, and risk-scoring inputs.
tasks.output_schema: Impact report markdown, machine-readable JSON, and deployment checklist.

documentation.changelog: Initial verified release based on the published marketplace skill documentation and repository reference materials.
